Structuring, process improvement and growth advisory grounded in how your business actually runs — not a slide deck from a consultant who's never seen your books.

Overview

Consultancy That's Grounded in Compliance Reality

Business advice that ignores tax and compliance implications often creates more problems than it solves. Because we already handle accounting, tax and compliance for our clients, our consultancy work is grounded in what's actually feasible for your business — not just what sounds good in theory.

We work with founders and business owners on structuring decisions, process gaps, and growth planning, with a clear eye on what each choice means for compliance and cost.

What We Offer

Advisory Across How Your Business Runs

🎯

Business Strategy

Structured input on strategic decisions — new markets, pricing, partnerships — grounded in your financial reality.

🏗️

Business Structuring

Guidance on entity structure, group structuring, or restructuring as your business evolves.

⚙️

Process Improvement

Identifying inefficiencies in financial and operational processes and recommending practical fixes.

📈

Business Growth Advisory

Advisory support as you plan expansion, new hires, or additional locations.

💡

Financial Decision Support

A second opinion on major financial decisions, backed by an understanding of your actual numbers.

🗂️

Operational Planning

Practical operational planning support tied to your financial capacity and compliance obligations.

Who Needs This

Founders Facing a Specific Decision

  • Founders deciding how to structure a new venture or subsidiary
  • Business owners planning expansion into a new city or market
  • Companies whose processes haven't scaled with their growth
  • Owners wanting an outside perspective before a major decision
  • Businesses considering restructuring to reduce compliance overhead

Benefits

What This Advisory Protects Against

  • Structuring decisions that create unnecessary compliance cost later
  • Growth plans that outpace your operational or financial capacity
  • Blind spots that come from only hearing internal perspectives
  • Advice disconnected from your actual tax and compliance position

Our Process

How We Work on Consultancy Engagements

1. Discovery

We understand the specific decision or problem you're working through.

2. Assessment

We review relevant financial and operational data to ground our recommendations in reality.

3. Recommendations

We present options with trade-offs clearly explained, not a single "right answer."

4. Implementation Support

Where needed, we support the compliance and filing work that comes with implementing the decision.
